description: Changes an existing room, live for the users inside. `data` replaces the room's shared state whole: call without confirm to learn what would be lost, then with confirm: true once the developer agrees. `moderators` replaces the list; ttlInactivity null returns to the app's value.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

data.description: The new shared state; replaces the whole object, no merge.

moderators.description: The complete new list of per-app user ids.

anyOf.description: Days without activity before Neblla deletes this room

ttlInactivity.description: Days without activity before Neblla deletes it, 0-3650 (0 = never; null = the app's value).

name: neblla_update_room
title: Change a room
